closed_relation_vocabulary.note: V2.1 (commit b54c8a6, contract SS2) adds ZERO new relation_type values. The validator's own vocabulary covers all 18 values Draft V2 SS2 names as usable: the 14 MVP_CORE_RELATION, 2 EXTENDED_RESEARCH_RELATION, and 2 REQUIRES_MORE_EVIDENCE_RELATION (MAINTAINS_PARALLEL_ALIGNMENT_WITH, scoped by the contract to Painan's own use; APPOINTS_OFFICE_HOLDER, zero instances so far). CASE_SPECIFIC_ONLY and ANNOTATION_NOT_RELATION tier values remain excluded. Any artifact using a value outside these 18 fails UNAPPROVED_RELATION_TYPE.

rules.description: Artifact must declare an explicit ontology_version equal to 'V2' or 'V2.1'.
rules.contract_section: Draft V2.1 SS3 (Version Support, this implementation's own design choice for the marker)

rules.description: ontology_version must be exactly one of the supported values; any other value fails deterministically.
CommercialRight/RightModification/CommandObservation/OperationParticipation entries accept only their exact contract field set; unrecognized extra fields fail.
RightModification.action must be one of GRANTS|WAIVES|RELEASES|REVOKES|RENEWS|EXEMPTS, quoted verbatim from DEC-04.
CommandObservation.coercion_status must be FREE|COERCED|CANNOT_DETERMINE.
CommandObservation.ability_to_refuse must be YES|NO|CANNOT_DETERMINE.
CommandObservation.voice_availability must be DOCUMENTED|ABSENT|CANNOT_DETERMINE.
CommandObservation.constrained_agency must be CONFIRMED|SUSPECTED|NOT_APPLICABLE|CANNOT_DETERMINE.

relation_type on any relation must belong to the closed 18-value vocabulary Draft V2 SS2 names as usable (14 MVP_CORE_RELATION + 2 EXTENDED_RESEARCH_RELATION + 2 REQUIRES_MORE_EVIDENCE_RELATION, the latter narrowly scoped per the contract's own text). Zero new values authorized by V2.1.
rules.contract_section: Draft V2.1 SS2 (UNCHANGED IN FULL); Draft V2 SS2

rules.description: CommandObservation.political_intent must be a free-text string (never validated as a closed enum); CANNOT_DETERMINE is an accepted string value.
Actor.explicit_non_identity_with must be a list of {actor_id, rationale} objects, never a single scalar.

resistance_target_actor_id must be a single actor_id (string), never a list. It is a SIBLING field directly on the relation, next to the existing resistance_candidate value -- never nested inside it (real artifacts store resistance_candidate as a bare descriptive string).
RightModification.right_id must reference an existing CommercialRight.right_id within the same artifact.
OperationParticipation.command_observation_id must reference an existing CommandObservation.observation_id within the same artifact.

SAFETY-CRITICAL: a CommandObservation's (commanding_actor_id, commanded_actor_id) pair must never simultaneously appear as the (subject_actor_id, object_id) pair of any relation. Without this check the entire safety rationale for CommandObservation is unenforced.
explicit_non_identity_with entries must reference an actor_id present in the artifact; an actor must not list itself; the relation must be symmetric (A lists B implies B lists A).

Every relation's subject endpoint (subject_actor_id, universal) and object endpoint (object_id, the V2.1-standardized generic field; or object_actor_id, Painan's own pre-standardization field, validated strictly against actor_id only) must reference an existing actor_id/location_id in the artifact -- no orphan endpoints, no silently-skipped endpoints, no unapproved endpoint field name. CORRECTED 2026-08-29: the prior implementation read only object_id and silently never validated Painan's object_actor_id-shaped relations (9/9, all resolved correctly on manual inspection -- a validator gap, not a Painan data defect). A relation with object_id explicitly null AND a populated commodity attribute is a valid DEC-19-shaped unary claim (no second endpoint required); null without commodity, or any endpoint-shaped field name outside {subject_actor_id, object_id, object_actor_id}, fails deterministically.
rules.contract_section: Draft V2 SS11; Draft V2.1 SS11

rules.description: resistance_target_actor_id (a sibling field on the relation, next to resistance_candidate) must reference an existing actor_id in the artifact.
Any relation/right/modification/observation carrying valid_from/valid_to must also carry date_precision; open_ended must be boolean when present.
rules.contract_section: Draft V2 SS5; Draft V2.1 SS5 (reused verbatim)

rules.description: Actor.mandate_scope/mandate_status, when the key is present, must not be an empty string (must remain temporally/substantively bounded per DEC-03's own safeguard).
Every CommercialRight/RightModification/CommandObservation/OperationParticipation entry must carry a non-empty source_document_ids list.
rules.contract_section: Draft V2.1 SS6 (reused verbatim from Draft V2)

rules.description: Every CommercialRight/RightModification/CommandObservation/OperationParticipation entry must explicitly carry researcher_review_required as a boolean (not omitted).

CommercialRight/RightModification/CommandObservation/OperationParticipation must declare public_status == RESEARCH_ONLY when the field is present; PUBLIC/PUBLIC_VOCABULARY/PRODUCTION/RUNTIME_APPROVED/GRAPHIFY_APPROVED/FACTUAL_EDGE all fail.

Actor identity-continuity fields (mandate_status, mandate_scope, identity_continuity_status, explicit_non_identity_with) and the relation-level resistance_target_actor_id: if a public_status override (resistance_target_public_status for the latter) is present it must equal RESEARCH_ONLY.
An artifact declaring ontology_version == V2 is not required to contain any V2.1 field or entity; their absence is not an error.

An artifact declaring ontology_version == V2 must not contain any V2.1-only top-level construct (research_only_entities list, or an actor/annotation carrying a V2.1-only field). Presence fails as an ambiguous version declaration rather than being silently accepted as migrated V2.1.
Any entity_type of InstitutionalStateObservation/InstitutionalPresenceObservation (CH-04 shape) fails as a deferred, not-yet-authorized structure.
Any Location field named source_place_expression/feature_type_confidence/spatial_scope_status (CH-05 shape) fails as a rejected structure.
Any entity_type DisputeSettlement (CH-08 shape) fails as a deferred, not-yet-authorized structure; REV-07 must never be represented as an executed V2.1 validation.

political_intent content is never semantically classified by the validator (no loyalty/resistance verdict is computed); presence is only structurally checked (R-VOC-07). Any populated, non-CANNOT_DETERMINE value is flagged REQUIRES_RESEARCHER_REVIEW, never PASS/FAIL on its substance.

mandate_status/identity_continuity_status/dependency_status values other than the explicit UNKNOWN/CANNOT_DETERMINE/NOT_TESTABLE markers are flagged REQUIRES_RESEARCHER_REVIEW; the validator confirms structural presence only, never the substantive claim.

interpretive_status/claim_or_effective_control/patron_client_classification/resistance_candidate values are checked only for closed-vocabulary conformance; the validator never adjudicates whether the underlying historical claim (resistance occurred, effective control existed, a patron-client relationship existed) is true.
